enabled.title: Apply saved settings automatically
enabled.description: On - saved changes are applied by the router itself after a short pause, even if the page was closed. Off - the settings are applied only by an explicit action.

pause_s.title: Pause after the last save, seconds
pause_s.description: Changes that follow one another within this pause are applied by one application.

sweep.title: Apply what was saved but not applied
sweep.description: Every few minutes, apply settings that were saved earlier (another window, an unavailable core, a reboot) and not applied. A rejected application is not repeated until the settings change.
